$comment: Fares are NOT in the GTFS feed — this file is the fare layer. 'tiers' are distance-based defaults (shape length in meters → UGX) drafted from public knowledge of Kampala taxi stage fares (2024/2025 era); they are deliberately coarse and shown as ranges in the UI. 'lineOverrides' pins exact fares for specific routes (route_id → UGX) as field validation progresses.
